main.description: Pull a hosted repo's shadowed COB records back from a given foster knot, rebuild the record chain under this knot's own authority, confirm record CIDs against foster knot's state, finally ack the handover. Since it may take a bit, the endpoint will already give a response as soon as the job is staged up with state "running". Then the next steps run in background finish into the sidecar + logs. Only a knot admin can call this!
